subtitle: Lesson 73 · Programming with T-SQL

eyebrow: The whole body is one SELECT
code:
CREATE FUNCTION dbo.ProductsBySubcategory
    (@SubcategoryID int)
RETURNS TABLE
AS
RETURN (
    SELECT ProductID, Name, ListPrice, StandardCost
    FROM Production.Product
    WHERE ProductSubcategoryID = @SubcategoryID
);
caption: No BEGIN/END, no column list — RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN (SELECT ...).

code:
SELECT * FROM dbo.ProductsBySubcategory(1);

SELECT p.Name, p.ListPrice, soh.OrderDate
FROM dbo.ProductsBySubcategory(1) AS p
JOIN Sales.SalesOrderDetail AS sod
    ON sod.ProductID = p.ProductID
JOIN Sales.SalesOrderHeader AS soh
    ON soh.SalesOrderID = sod.SalesOrderID;
caption: It returns rows, so you query it like a table — and you can JOIN it.
